{{also|For other characters of the same name, see [[Bobby Bill]], [[Bobby Blue]], [[Bobby Jefferson]], [[Bobby Jo Roberts]] or [[Bobby Konders]].}}
'''Bobby''' is, presumably, a member of the [[Sindacco Family]], a cosa nostra mob family. Bobby lives on the East coast of the United States of America, which could be [[Liberty City in GTA III Era|Liberty City]], [[Carcer City]] or [[Vice City in GTA III Era|Vice City]]. It is mentioned by two members of the Sindacco family that he had recently become an open homosexual.
